He could be the person named "gtsang pa sangs rgyas bzang po" (ID:6306) listed as 29th abbot of the lower monastery of gSang phu (ID:6158) ([MPRU5QUC]: 210).
He was active after 1219 as his epistemological work (ID:4781) addresses the views of upholders of  the Tshad ma rigs gter (ID:5564) (the "rigs gter ba").
name: sangs rgyas bzang po (1)
